title: Undirected Cycle Detection
statement:
Use DFS with edge IDs to detect whether an undirected multigraph contains a cycle. A self-loop or a pair of parallel edges counts as a cycle.

Input
n m followed by m undirected edges.

Output
Print YES if a cycle exists and NO otherwise.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000, 0 ≤ m ≤ 200000. Endpoints are in [1,n]. Parallel edges and self-loops are allowed.
